messages:
Priya (CS): SailWave wants a short APAC demo tomorrow 09:00 SGT and asked for a temporary QPS bump + CIDR allowlist. Can NetOps provision?
Devon (NetOps): sure. need CIDRs, hosted/dedicated, and how long.
Priya (CS): Hosted. account ID: SW-4120. CIDRs: 103.21.56.0/22 and 18.130.45.32/27. Requested: 150 qps for 48h starting 2026-06-03T09:00+08:00.
Ravi (AM): renewal in 5 weeks; success here helps conversion. Please mark as priority.
Elaine (Support): they hit 429s when routed through us-west last week. APAC edge should fix it. Add monitoring for 429/5xx on rollout.
Devon (NetOps): plan: create scoped allowlist, route to ap-southeast-1, rate_override 150 qps, auto-revoke after 48h. Will add canary: 5m at 30% traffic.
Priya (CS): add auto-revoke tag and post-change reminder to the customer-success channel.
Devon (NetOps): CR created CR-20260603-721. Scheduled apply 2026-06-03T01:50:00Z (pre-checks), canary 5m, full at 09:00 SGT.
ops-bot: Change request CR-20260603-721 created and scheduled.
Devon (NetOps): deploying config snippet to ticket:
```
allowlist: ["103.21.56.0/22","18.130.45.32/27"]
route: ap-southeast-1
rate_limit_override: 150 qps
autorevoke: 48h
canary: {duration: 5m, pct: 30}
alerts: post to #customer-health and SW-4120 channel if 429s >0.5% in 5m
```
Elaine (Support): I'll monitor the channel during rollout and escalate if errors spike.
Ravi (AM): I'll collect latency/cost numbers and join the post-demo sync.
Priya (CS): thanks team — please paste final applied config and CR link after apply so I can update SailWave.
Devon (NetOps): applied and verified. Canary showed healthy 429/5xx rates <0.1%. Full rollout completed at 09:00 SGT. Auto-revoke set for 48h. CR link: https://redwood.ops/changes/CR-20260603-721
Priya (CS): SailWave confirmed lower latency and no 429s in the first 30 minutes. I'll capture feedback and flag for renewal outreach. :rocket:
